text:
maria: morning async check-in
what I did: finished auth refactor + added token validation schema, opened PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482
blockers: rate-limit e2e failing in staging — seeing intermittent 429s during burst tests, unsure if it's gateway or client retry loop
today: debug rate-limit, pair with sam to reproduce, address any header size issues that tara mentioned

alex: thanks — taking a look at the auth PR now. quick note: the middleware migration changed header parsing order, i'll leave comments where it affects existing handlers

sam: I can pair at 10:30. i ran the burst locally and saw the client retry loop causing 2x traffic. suggestion: ensure gateway returns `Retry-After` and clients honor it. also can share a reproducer

jon: rolled out a routing micro-optimization yesterday — reduced route-table lookup for default routes. canary in us-west so far, p50 latency down ~12ms. no errors reported from canary

tara: small heads-up: dedicated capacity tests surfaced auth header truncation when token >2kb. looks like proxy truncation. may be unrelated to auth refactor but worth verifying header preservation across proxy chain

maria: good catches. alex @jon can you two check whether the middleware reorder touches header size handling? sam i'll drop staging logs + reproducer in a DM and we can pair at 10:30

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed: routing-service v2.14 -> 100% in us-west at 2025-04-17T11:02:12Z :white_check_mark:

jon: noted. i'll add a regression test for header passthrough and ping infra about proxy buffers

infra: we traced the staging nginx -> envoy combo. increasing `proxy_buffer_size` and `proxy_buffers` in staging to avoid truncation. will monitor. config change rolled at 11:20 UTC

sam: perfect, thanks infra. i'll verify the reproducer against the updated staging and report back

maria: blockers summary: rate-limit 429s (sam+me pairing), possible header truncation (infra mitigation in staging). next steps: finish auth PR review (alex), run e2e after infra change, merge if green. ping here with any urgent regressions

alex: on it. rough note to reviewers: focus on the auth header parsing and the `X-Request-Id` propagation — saw one missing trace in staging logs

jon: adding a canary metric dashboard for the routing change, will post link when available

maria: thanks team — i'll update the ticket with these items and close the loop after the pair session

sam: :thumbsup:
